_comment: Example MCP server config. Copy to a path your Claude Code installation reads (typically ~/.claude/.mcp.json or a project-level .mcp.json) and edit. Never commit a populated copy of this file with real tokens — keep it untracked.
_governance: All MCP calls pass through hooks/mcp-security-gate.sh against recipes/lib/mcp-whitelist.json. Write-capable servers require explicit whitelisting.

filesystem._notes: Replace <workspace> with the absolute path you want exposed (typically a single project root). Avoid exposing $HOME.

github._security: Token must come from an env var, not be inlined. Scope: minimum needed (repo read, optional issues/PRs). Rotate every 90 days.

postgres._security: Prefer a read-only role for the connection string. Never use a superuser.

_publishing_rule: If you copy this template, the populated file MUST be in your .gitignore. Real tokens, real connection strings, and real workspace paths must never be committed.
